Name: Casino Unlimited Stock
Author: Kalaina
Description: A simple Content Patcher mod to remove the purchase limits on the standard items in the casino shop (Magnets, Hardwood Fences, Warp Totem: Farm, and the three kinds of fireworks). If you want to convert casino coins into money, you can buy and then ship the items. For game version 1.6+.

Manifest.Name: Casino Unlimited Stock
Manifest.Description: Gives the casino shop an unlimited supply of its normally-limited items.
